idea-plugin.name: Obsidian IDE Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Obsidian IDE Bridge for JetBrains

Integrate your Obsidian vault directly into JetBrains IDEs. Navigate [[wiki-links]], view backlinks, parse YAML frontmatter, search vault metadata, and bridge TODO/FIXME comments with Obsidian notes — all without leaving the IDE.

Features

  • Wiki-link navigation and autocompletion
  • Backlinks panel
  • Single and multi-vault support
  • Vault-wide full-text search
  • Frontmatter parsing and display
  • Interactive graph view (D3.js)
  • Code ↔ Notes bridging (TODO/FIXME linking)
  • Tag tree navigation
  • Daily notes integration
  • Templates with variable substitution

Works with IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, CLion, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, RubyMine, and Android Studio.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New in 2026.2.4

  • Marketplace Ready — Added support contact and plugin metadata.

What's New in 2026.2.3

  • Renamed — Plugin renamed to Obsidian IDE Bridge to avoid Marketplace naming conflicts.

What's New in 2026.2.2

  • Comprehensive Tests — Added 40+ unit tests covering license, search, indexing, models, and utilities.
  • Feature Enhancements — All features (Graph, Tags, Daily Notes, Templates, Bridge) available to all users.

What's New in 2026.2.1

  • Startup Indexing — Vaults are automatically indexed on project open.
  • Status Bar Widget — See vault and note count at a glance.
  • Wiki-Link Line Markers — Gutter icons for wiki-link detection.
  • Wiki-Link Completion — Autocomplete note titles inside [[...]].
  • Feature Management — All features available to all users.
  • Index Persistence — Cached note hashes for faster incremental re-indexing.
  • Vault Diagnostics — New action to inspect vault health and statistics.
  • Notification Support — Balloon notifications for indexing and warnings.
  • Progress Indicator — Re-index action now shows background progress.
  • Package Rename — Migrated from dev.htmeta to com.jakubjirak namespace.

What's New in 2026.2.0

  • Initial Release — Production-ready plugin.
  • Vault registration and validation with persistent settings.
  • Fast incremental indexing via VFS file watchers.
  • Wiki-link recognition, navigation, and autocompletion.
  • Backlinks tool window with context preview.
  • Tag tree panel with hierarchical navigation.
  • Vault-wide full-text search with filter chips.
  • Code ↔ Notes bridging for TODO/FIXME comments.
  • Interactive graph visualization via JCEF/D3.js.
  • Daily notes quick action.
  • Template engine with variable substitution.
  • Settings panel under Tools → Obsidian IDE Bridge.
  • All vector SVG icons; no until-build cap for future compatibility.
